items.author: Jeffrey Shaffer (co-author of The Big Book of Dashboards, Director of AI Strategy at U. Cincinnati), Oct 23
items.summary: He ran 25 slide decks (1,690 slides) through his vibe-coded PowerPoint accessibility tool. Version 2 writes alt text with OpenAI and Anthropic models, and he argues that Microsoft, Google, Adobe and Canvas should let AI agents handle accessibility.

items.author: Przemek Harazny (Power BI architect), Oct 23
items.summary: His Semantic Model Viewer for VS Code now lets you pick a table or column and trace every measure that depends on it, along with its DAX, in one view.

items.author: Priya P., Oct 23
items.summary: An infographic on upcoming Power Platform retirements: AI Builder credits become Copilot Credits (Nov 1, 2026), Vibe and App Builder move to Copilot Studio (Nov 30, 2026), Dataverse for Teams goes away (late 2026), and Power BI Q&A gives way to Copilot in Power BI (Feb 2027).

items.author: Travere Therapeutics
items.summary: Senior Director, Commercial Analytics & Decision Science — Travere Therapeutics — Remote US — posted Oct 24 — $219K to $285K — Builds a centralized commercial analytics function, its roadmap and a small team. Asks for 12+ years in pharma or biotech commercial analytics. No BI tool named.

items.author: Alignment Health
items.summary: Director, Analytics — Alignment Health — Remote US — posted Oct 23 — $149.9K to $224.8K — A player-coach role over analytics strategy, executive reporting and data products. Asks for 12+ years of experience and 5+ years leading people, with Medicare experience preferred. Mentions Tableau and Power BI.

items.author: UnitedHealthcare
items.summary: Director, Operational Excellence, UHC Data and Analytics — UnitedHealthcare — Remote (Minnetonka, MN) — posted Oct 24 — $134.6K to $230.8K — Mostly budgeting, financial planning and workforce management for a data org, plus dashboards and scorecards. Asks for 10+ years. Mentions Power BI.
